arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import statistics

# Original nominal values (in millions)
nominal_1992 = 144724
nominal_1993 = 158633
nominal_1994 = 166731

# CPI-U annual averages
cpi_1992 = 140.3
cpi_1993 = 144.5
cpi_1994 = 148.2

# Adjust to constant 1994 dollars
# Real = Nominal × (target_CPI / source_CPI)
real_1992 = nominal_1992 * (cpi_1994 / cpi_1992)
real_1993 = nominal_1993 * (cpi_1994 / cpi_1993)
real_1994 = nominal_1994 * (cpi_1994 / cpi_1994)

print(f'Real 1992: {real_1992}')
print(f'Real 1993: {real_1993}')
print(f'Real 1994: {real_1994}')

# Calculate sample z-score for 1994
# Standard deviation uses n-1 (sample stdev)
adjusted_values = [real_1992, real_1993, real_1994]
mean = statistics.mean(adjusted_values)
stdev = statistics.stdev(adjusted_values)

print(f'Mean: {mean}')
print(f'Stdev (n-1): {stdev}')

z_score = (real_1994 - mean) / stdev
print(f'Z-score: {z_score}')
print(f'Z-score rounded to 2 decimals: {round(z_score, 2)}')
"
